import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

public class PD {
    public static void main(String... args) throws IOException {
        FastReader in = new FastReader();
        long n = in.nextInt();
        long m = in.nextInt();
        System.out.println(solve(n, m));
    }

    static long solve(long a, long b) {
        long x1 = Math.min(a, b);
        long x2 = Math.max(a, b);
        if (x1 == 1) {
            long[] memo = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
            return x1 * x2 - memo[(int) (x2 % 6)];
        }
        if (x1 == 2) {
            if (x2 == 2) {
                return 0;
            }
            if (x2 == 3 || x2 == 7) {
                return x1 * x2 - 2;
            }
            return x1 * x2;
        }
        long product = x1 * x2;
        return (product & 1) == 0 ? product : product - 1;
    }

    static class FastReader {
        private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 12;
        private DataInputStream din;
        private byte[] buffer;
        private int bufferPointer, bytesRead;

        FastReader() {
            din = new DataInputStream(System.in);
            buffer = new byte[BUFFER_SIZE];
            bufferPointer = bytesRead = 0;
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int ret = 0;
            byte c = read();
            while (c <= ' ') {
                c = read();
            }
            boolean neg = (c == '-');
            if (neg) {
                c = read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = read();
            }
            return neg ? -ret : ret;
        }

        private void fillBuffer() throws IOException {
            bytesRead = din.read(buffer, bufferPointer = 0, BUFFER_SIZE);
            if (bytesRead == -1) {
                buffer[0] = -1;
            }
        }

        private byte read() throws IOException {
            if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) {
                fillBuffer();
            }
            return buffer[bufferPointer++];
        }
    }
}

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class PD {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        long n = fs.nextInt();
        long m = fs.nextInt();

        long x1 = Math.min(n, m);
        long x2 = Math.max(n, m);
        long answer;

        switch ((int) x1) {
            case 1:
                int[] rem = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
                answer = x1 * x2 - rem[(int) (x2 % 6)];
                break;
            case 2:
                if (x2 == 2) {
                    answer = 0;
                } else if (x2 == 3 || x2 == 7) {
                    answer = x1 * x2 - 2;
                } else {
                    answer = x1 * x2;
                }
                break;
            default:
                answer = x1 * x2;
                if ((answer & 1) != 0) {
                    answer--;
                }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    private static int parseInt(String s) {
        int result = 0;
        boolean negative = false;
        int i = 0;
        if (s.charAt(0) == '-') {
            negative = true;
            i = 1;
        }
        for (; i < s.length(); i++) {
            result = result * 10 + s.charAt(i) - '0';
        }
        return negative ? -result : result;
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        private final BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return parseInt(next());
        }
    }
}

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

public class PD {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        byte[] data = readAllBytes();
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner(data);
        long n = fs.nextInt();
        long m = fs.nextInt();

        long x1 = Math.min(n, m);
        long x2 = Math.max(n, m);
        long answer = x1 * x2;
        long[] memo = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};

        if (x1 == 1) {
            answer -= memo[(int) (x2 % 6)];
        } else if (x1 == 2) {
            if (x2 == 2) {
                answer = 0;
            } else if (x2 == 3 || x2 == 7) {
                answer -= 2;
            }
        } else {
            answer &= ~1L;
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    private static byte[] readAllBytes() throws IOException {
        DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(System.in);
        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[4096];
        int read;
        while ((read = dis.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            bos.write(buffer, 0, read);
        }
        dis.close();
        return bos.toByteArray();
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        private final byte[] data;
        private int pos;

        FastScanner(byte[] data) {
            this.data = data;
        }

        int nextInt() {
            byte c = read();
            while (c <= ' ') {
                c = read();
            }
            boolean neg = (c == '-');
            if (neg) {
                c = read();
            }
            int ret = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                ret = ret * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = read();
            }
            return neg ? -ret : ret;
        }

        private byte read() {
            if (pos >= data.length) return -1;
            return data[pos++];
        }
    }
}
